recommendation.source: Owner-only, default-disabled daily aggregate counters in existing staging DO with authenticated owner-only aggregate read, independently of quota enforcement.
recommendation.privacy: Match trusted owner identity inside runtime; no identity or tenant key stored or returned; no raw event rows or content; bounded 31-day buckets; coarse tool/status/duration/bytes only.
recommendation.limits: Preserve existing lifetime operation budget, request limits, storage, runtime expiry and production. Swallow telemetry failure. Fresh independent review before activation.
recommendation.measurement: Idle or disabled instrumentation cannot establish normal or extreme usage; no threshold recommendation from absent data.
recommendation.retention: At most 31 dated buckets; pruning on reads/writes does not promise physical timed deletion while idle.

proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.purpose: Observe owner's normal Bee work, not synthetic load or free quota enforcement.
proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.scope: Existing staging owner connection supplies measured usage; instrument is owner-only, execution is not owner-exclusive because other approved admission remains unchanged. Preserve lifetime caps and halt unexpected traffic. No new enrollment, grants, billing or production.
proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.sourceGate: Exact reviewed telemetry main commit/module and successful staging build; independent privacy and source gates before candidate.

preserve: All other metadata/bindings and inherited secrets
Existing KV/DO, Container immutable image/private network/logs disabled
Lifetime validation requests 10000 and signup operations 100000; no resets

Access applications, staging hostname, production source/deployment/settings
proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.execution: GET active version/settings/Container/Access/production; clone full writable version, inherit secrets, change only approved flag and timestamps; upload deploy=false; GET exact source/bindings/metadata and unchanged active deployment; explicit deploy; GET effective source/settings/Container/Access/production; independent deployed acceptance before measurement.
proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.shutdown: Retain exact expiry until scheduled destruction. Never early restore to older expiry and invalidate scheduled shutdown. Observe actual inactive after deadline plus at most 10-minute accepted tail. No automatic extension or additional runtime after expiry. If no active session observes then, report unobserved rather than claim monitoring.
proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.activity: Owner uses normal existing Bee connection for own work; no agent generates load merely to fill telemetry. Baseline and after aggregates only; classify harness validation separately from normal usage. Do not call raw profile or transcript to establish measurement.

cost.assumptions: One max instance, 0.25 vCPU at full utilization, 1GiB RAM, 4GB disk for entire 2h+10min; one 128MB DO continuously active.
cost.limits: Linear estimates exclude request/storage/egress and provider billable-unit rounding. Included account allowances and historical remaining approval unknown. Prior accepted conservative history ~0.631 Container +0.130 DO and subsequent observed expired/inactive periods support plausibility, not full invoice proof. Halt on unexpected traffic/configuration or inability reasonably to remain under settled approval.

proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.retention: 31 days of bounded owner aggregates, not 31 days of open runtime; pruning on read/write, not guaranteed physical timed deletion.
proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.outcome: Actual measured usage can inform a proposed monthly free amount later. No sample yet and no threshold selected.
proposedNaturalUsageEnvelope.measurementGate: After exact-source review/deployment, independently accept phase A: enable OWNER_USAGE_ENABLED only, preserving already-expired runtime timestamps. Read back version/settings and inactive Container. Rediscover actual native bee_observed_usage and obtain initial aggregate readback; registration is flag-gated, so catalog availability cannot precede flag-only activation. Phase B may open the bounded 2-hour runtime only after actual tool/readback availability and separate exact candidate acceptance. Subsequent observed aggregates must follow waitUntil completion before persistence claims. No provider RPC bypass or OAuth re-pair inference.
